summary: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd, a Nasdaq-listed Chinese foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing an exhibit containing a September 17, 2026 Nasdaq Listing Qualifications notice that it regained compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(1), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The ADS bid price stayed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from September 2 to September 16, 2026, closing the matter. No deal, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are involved; the prior July 23, 2026 deficiency notice is resolved, and no arbitrage angle applies.
